lyrics_online.speaker: Setup Wizard
lines: You can search for lyrics online from LRCPlus.\n

search_failed.speaker: Setup Wizard
lines: Yikes... something went wrong with the search. \toggleoutsideclickWant to try again?\button(Try again,lyrics_retry)\button(Continue,lyrics_continue)

no_results.speaker: Setup Wizard
lines: No lyrics this time... \toggleoutsideclickMaybe try a different search?\button(Try again,lyrics_retry)\button(Continue,lyrics_continue)

results_found.speaker: Setup Wizard
lines: There we go! You can pick a result to take a closer look.\wait(3)\res\cr6

lyrics_retry.speaker: Setup Wizard
lines: Go ahead, give it another try.\waitevent(lyrics_search_started)

lyrics_continue.speaker: Setup Wizard
lines: No worries, you can always search again later.\wait(2)\res\cr6
